bagPolicy.summary: Bags smaller than 14 x 14 x 6 inches are allowed at Oakland Arena. Backpacks of any size are not, and there is no bag check.
allowed: Bags smaller than 14 x 14 x 6 inches
Still cameras with a lens shorter than 3 inches, and camera cases
prohibited: Bags larger than 14 x 14 x 6 inches
Outside food and drinks, including liquids of any kind
Hard-sided containers: bottles, cans, flasks, coolers and thermoses
Cameras with a lens longer than 3 inches, and video cameras
Selfie sticks, tripods, and poles or sticks of any size
bagPolicy.note: Bag check is not open for events at Oakland Arena, so a bag that is too big has to go back to your car. Everything is searched at the door. The camera rule can vary by event.

parking.note: Parking is available at the Oakland Arena with various options for attendees. It's recommended to arrive early to secure a spot and check the website for any specific event-related parking details.

rideshare.note: Use Baldwin Gate for rideshare pickup and drop-off. The gate opens two hours before the event.

concessions.note: Oakland Arena offers a variety of food and drink options including elevated arena classics and specialty items. Guests can enjoy draft beer, craft cocktails, and a range of food from nachos and hot dogs to international delicacies. The venue is 100% cashless.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Oakland Arena also offers accessible parking, which is located in the first two rows of the parking lot, closest to Oakland Arena. Wheelchair accessible restrooms are located throughout Oakland Arena.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: No re-entry is permitted after you have exited Oakland Arena. Exiting and re-entering the stadium with the same ticket is NOT permitted.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will call is on the Plaza Level at the arena box office. Collect only on event day. Bring valid photo ID matching the name on the ticket envelope.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For most shows, doors open one hour before the scheduled performance time.
